# OneTHU 0.11.4 · Revolution

- 新增独立 OneTHU CLI、SDK 与桌面内置常驻后台，共享登录和任务；已授权任务可在关闭 App 后继续检查和归档课程资料。
- OH 接入雨课堂、OneTHU 好友、组织项目与公告、清小搭技能及智能体、暂存箱收纳和短口令分享。
- 修复 IM 配置与上下文存储冲突、请求运行状态、桌面/CLI 会话移交及云盘自动连接。
- 修复网络学堂通知附件命名和格式识别，合入玻璃、壁纸、标签页与 OH 交互优化。

macOS ARM64 · Windows x64 · Android ARM64。Android 沿用正式签名和原版 Logo，versionCode **11013**。独立 CLI 和 SDK 压缩包一并提供；移动端不包含 Node 常驻后台。应用本地数据接口需运行 App，具体能力和授权边界见指南。

[中文说明](https://onethu.github.io/docs/release-0.11.4/) · [CLI 指南](https://onethu.github.io/docs/onethu-cli/) · [清华云盘下载](https://cloud.tsinghua.edu.cn/d/56f78a2a0b144a6ab737/)

# OneTHU 0.11.4 · Revolution

- Adds a standalone OneTHU CLI and SDK, plus a resident desktop backend sharing sign-in and tasks. Approved checks and course-resource archiving can continue after the app closes.
- OH gains Rain Classroom, OneTHU contacts, organization projects and announcements, Xiaoda skills and agents, and staging-box collection and short-code sharing.
- Fixes IM configuration/context storage conflicts, request lifecycle handling, desktop/CLI session handoff and cloud reconnection.
- Corrects learning-notice attachment names and extensions; includes glass, wallpaper, tab and OH interaction improvements.

macOS ARM64 · Windows x64 · Android ARM64. Android keeps its production signing certificate and canonical logo, with versionCode **11013**. Standalone CLI and SDK archives are included. Mobile does not include the resident Node backend; app-local data services require the app to run. See the guides for supported operations and authorization boundaries.

[English notes](https://onethu.github.io/docs/en/release-0.11.4/) · [CLI guide](https://onethu.github.io/docs/en/onethu-cli/) · [Tsinghua Cloud downloads](https://cloud.tsinghua.edu.cn/d/56f78a2a0b144a6ab737/)
